title: Decision Workflow and Monitoring
purpose: Compose the Step 10-25 reference engines into an ordered, company-scoped decision lifecycle and translate evidence-backed watch conditions into requests for a new decision run.

rules: A missing or malformed gate is review_required.
ready requires at least one eligible_option_id.
Only ready proceeds to preference application, comparison, prediction, ranking, and best-action selection.
Hard-constraint uncertainty must never be converted into an eligible option.

limits: Watch evaluation is pure and does not dispatch work.
The host scheduler, event source, store, and notification service remain external.
Stale, expired, missing, or unknown evidence produces an unknown state.

invariants: company_id is the only company boundary.
Every workflow request requires decision, run, and idempotency identifiers.
Every artifact with company_id must match the request company_id.
Legacy tenant_id and tenant_company_id fields are rejected.
Workflow events summarize stage transitions and hash outputs without copying raw stage payloads.
A watch can request a decision rerun but cannot execute a recommended action.
Recommendations, watch triggers, and learning updates have authority_effect none.
History and learning persistence are provided by explicit host adapters.
non_goals: Domain-specific browser, shopping, coupon, affiliate, or order-tracking behavior
